message:
Skip loading Python download metadata when listing installed interpreters (#21925)

the metadata is not necessary for listing installed pythons, so skip
loading it.

benchmarking locally:

Case | Before | After | Reduction
-- | -- | -- | --
--only-installed, two interpreters | 37.38 ms | 15.55 ms | 58.4%
--only-installed, no interpreters | 36.24 ms | 14.62 ms | 59.7%
--only-downloads 3.12 control | 34.42 ms | 34.32 ms | 0.3%
